prior_problem: Regional innovation, exposure and use have different geographies
our_design_choice: RQ1; distinguish transferred regional exposure from adoption
current_evidence: Disclosed-cell support and alternative transfer diagnostics
non_comparability: Implementation gaps and actual regional use are unobserved

prior_problem: Age adjustment and hiring may differ from exposed employment totals
our_design_choice: RQ1 and national age contrasts; keep employment and hiring separate
current_evidence: No robust regional displacement; selected Norwegian signals are specification-sensitive
non_comparability: Different ages, full-time/education filters, scores and time resolution; matched EU27 quarterly table pending

prior_problem: Norwegian estimates and backdated comparisons question a common post-2022 break
our_design_choice: RQ1 sensitivity; retain pre-periods and compare endpoint/average windows
current_evidence: Same205-cell Norwegian bridge can change sign across time windows
non_comparability: Our selected counties and two-digit proxy do not reproduce their firm/register designs

prior_problem: A complete young-worker exposure distribution yields an imprecise zero
our_design_choice: RQ1 support diagnostics; avoid selected occupations as population evidence
current_evidence: The ≥50-cell regional DID is not significant on107 regions
non_comparability: Disclosure support is not complete occupational coverage; our Norwegian curves are not a refutation

prior_problem: French hiring and separations may react before employment stocks
our_design_choice: RQ2 motivates sector/age diagnosis and future flow data
current_evidence: ICT centre estimates differ from finance but are weighting- and rounding-sensitive
non_comparability: Regional stocks and French sample-composition transfers cannot establish a recruitment mechanism

prior_problem: Task reorganisation can coexist with small mean hours/earnings effects
our_design_choice: RQ1–RQ3; distinguish non-detection in stocks from absence of task change
current_evidence: Our regional estimates do not establish a robust differential decline
non_comparability: We do not observe adoption, tasks, hours or the Danish treatment comparison

prior_problem: AI assistance can improve workplace productivity, especially for novices
our_design_choice: RQ3 is an exposure-composition association, not a comparable adoption effect
current_evidence: A0.01 THAIE difference is associated with6.60% higher real GVA/worker
non_comparability: The6.60% cross-sectional association and15% workplace effect have different treatments, units and populations

prior_problem: Junior-task automation may alter entry into experience-intensive careers
our_design_choice: Future test; theory motivates hiring, training and career-progression data
current_evidence: Current stock and age-ratio outcomes do not test learning losses
non_comparability: Conditional theoretical mechanism, not an observed European long-run effect
